english.title: Contravene Article 14(1) of Regulation (EC) No. 178/2002 (food safety requirements)
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 4 and 5 of the General Food Regulations 2004.

Date and Location
placed unsafe food on the market

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Article 14(1) of Regulation (EC) No. 178/2002 prohibits the placing of 'unsafe' food on the market
(ii) For other offences under regulation 4 of the General Food Regulations 2004 see H15225.
(iii) These provisions were repealed in relation to England on 31st December 2013, however the offence remains in force in Wales - For offences in Wales from 31 December 2013, see document H19573.
